We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation. On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets. Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021. What you'll do As an AI Engineer, you develop MAIA further and help decide from the start how we solve problems. What you can work on: From concept to feature. Together with product management, you sharpen rough concepts and own features from prototype to continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data. Chat and agents. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context and letting agents complete multi-step tasks, with traceable progress and verifiable results. Unlocking company knowledge. You connect external systems and make knowledge from many different file formats usable. This way, MAIA finds the right passages, delivers answers with sources and respects existing access rights. Models and quality. You integrate new language models and compare quality, cost and speed. With evals, you detect errors and systematically improve answers and agents. Secure, fast and stable. You build isolated environments for running code and tools and improve response times and data processing, so that MAIA runs reliably even with large knowledge bases. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig. Was du bei uns machst Als unsere erste dedizierte DevOps-Person verantwortest du Infrastruktur und Betrieb von MAIA und entwickelst unsere bestehende Plattform für den nächsten Wachstumsschritt weiter. Die Rolle lebt von enger Abstimmung mit dem Engineering-Team. Woran du arbeiten kannst: Plattform und Deployments. Der Großteil unserer Infrastruktur läuft bei Hetzner, auf dedizierten Servern und Cloud-VMs. Du betreibst diese selbst administrierten Linux-Systeme und bindest ergänzend Dienste von AWS, Azure und GCP an, vor allem für KI-Services. Du setzt Least Privilege, Secrets Management, Vulnerability Scanning und Patch Management konsequent um. Für unser laufe

jobs.title: Strategic Account Director
jobs.description: About Payoneer Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories. By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence. Role Summary   Location: London Hybrid Full-Time   The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit — from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job. This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO s and Treasurer s office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer. This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. You will work hand in hand with regional heads of sales for in-market coordination and, over time, help shape how this function scales across the field.   What You ll Do     Hunt and land net-new strategic accounts. jobs.title: Senior Quantum Applications Architect
jobs.description: PsiQuantum s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.   Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.   Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.   That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum s most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Veriff Network
jobs.description: About Veriff Veriff is building trust infrastructure for the internet. Our AI-powered identity verification and fraud prevention platform helps businesses across fintech, crypto, gaming, mobility and marketplaces know who their users are, and whether they can be trusted, in 230+ countries and territories. We build our own technology end to end, and every verification we run teaches us something about how fraud really works. The role Veriff sees fraud at a scale and breadth that no single platform can see on its own. Our job now is to turn that advantage into products customers can see, measure and act on, and to build the network that makes it compound. As Lead Product Manager for Fraud on the Veriff Network team, you will make the fraud detection, prevention and accuracy strengths of our product legible to customers. You will own the concrete product experiences that do this, such as a Feedback API that lets customers tell us what happened after a decision, fraud insights inside Station (our customer portal), and automated fraud reporting. You will also lead the customer engagement that turns those experiences into a feedback loop: customers share outcomes and signals, our detection gets sharper, and every platform on the network benefits. This is one of the first roles on the Veriff Network, and it directly shapes how we package, sell and grow our fraud offering. What success looks like In your first 90 days, you will have assessed our fraud product roadmap and packaging and agreed a revised version with product and fraud leadership. You will have identified the top three to five fraud product improvements, with the highest-priority items shaped and in development. By six months, the first updated fraud product offering is live with a group of design and beta partners. You understand that great models are not just accurate in notebooks—they are usable, explainable, and measurable inside a real product. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. The role will be based at our Rissington branch and is a full-time position, working four days per week. At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners. Practice Highlights Located in the heart of Cheltenham, renowned for horse racing and a thriving bar and restaurant scene, Dragon Vets is an established practice and has invested in specialist equipment including CT, DR, rigid and flexible endoscopy, high-end Doppler ultrasonography and well-equipped operating facilities including laparoscopic kits and TPLO kits, and much more. Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten. Wenn du Lust hast, Recruiting strategisch mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig hands-on zu arbeiten, könnte das perfekt zu dir passen. Who We Want Experienced and growth-oriented. Startup-minded and fast-paced. Du fühlst dich in dynamischen Umfeldern wohl, priorisierst

jobs.description: Principal Engineer About this role The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default. Your mindset The mindset is the engine, and it is almost impossible to teach retrospectively. You are intellectually honest about uncertainty, taking a trust-but-verify approach and assuming the surprising bug is the one that will burn. jobs.description: Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement. Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . You are the person who takes a messy, high-stakes, multi-threaded sales process and makes the future state obvious and credible, working strategically with the world's largest logos. Solution Consulting is not an established playbook you're stepping into. You're building it.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. jobs.title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
jobs.description: Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later. About the Role You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach. We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle. The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours. It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields. jobs.description: Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines. In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device. The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks: Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow. Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints. Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into architecture simulators, enabling design space exploration across the full heterogeneous system. Investigate hardware/software co-design strategies for mapping real-world applications — particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and signal processing kernels — onto the ternary IMC fabric, exploiting approximate computing techniques to trade precision for energy efficiency. jobs.title: Lead Tech SRE
jobs.description: About Kestra Kestra is the universal orchestration platform : open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community. About the role Kestra Cloud is our fully managed SaaS edition of Kestra. Each customer gets a dedicated Kestra instance on dedicated infrastructure, so the platform is a fleet of isolated stacks rather than one shared cluster. It is in Beta today, running production workloads for early customers, with General Availability planned for 2027. Each instance runs arbitrary user code (scripts, containers, queries against their own systems) through hundreds of plugins, and the fleet grows with every new customer. Provisioning, upgrading, and observing dozens to hundreds of identical stacks without drift is the core problem. We're looking for a Lead Tech SRE to own Kestra Cloud end to end: the architecture and specs, the delivery, the monitoring, and the continuous improvement of the platform. You decide how the platform should evolve, write it down, split it into work, and ship it with your team. You would lead a team of three, yourself included. That means you stay hands-on (a large share of your week is Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, and incident work) while setting the technical direction, reviewing designs, and dispatching work to two SREs. You work closely with the CTO, the platform engineering teams building the Kestra core, and our security engineer. This is an engineering leadership role, not a people-management-only one. jobs.title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
jobs.description: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01 Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten. Over de functie Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar): Werk je in dagdienst Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01 Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek. In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028): Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. jobs.title: Talent Partner - Manufacturing and Industrial
jobs.description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. We're scaling incredibly fast, and our manufacturing capability is central to our future. As our Talent Partner, you'll be focused on hiring workers across the manufacturing lifecycle. What You Will Do Develop and nurture talent pools across the manufacturing space, such as facilities managers and factory technicians, to ensure consistent delivery across high-volume pipelines. Build a robust employer brand, enabling microagi to be known as a competitive employer in an emerging industrial startup ecosystem. Advise the team on best practices for building out and scaling manufacturing recruiting. Plan and attend industry events to further our market presence amongst the best manufacturing talent. Privately-held and VC-funded, we have a global team of over 400 Aeranauts – and we’re growing. We deliver Decision Intelligence innovation and services that enable enterprises to automate and scale decision making with accuracy and speed. We continue to be the trusted choice of market leaders for our proven ability to generate value and unlock opportunities that were previously unattainable. The Principal Solution Engineer supports sales efforts throughout the sales cycle to win new customers, as well as retain and expand existing customers. You will be a key contributor and subject matter expert, owning vital activities that help prospects and customers navigate their selection and decision-making process. You will be the "tip of the spear" in our go-to-market strategy, working closely with our Product Management and Marketing teams, providing feedback on market requirements, helping to drive the product development roadmap. jobs.description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. jobs.title: Meeloopstage Cash Control/ Finance
jobs.description: Wil jij ontdekken hoe de financiële motor achter een internationale logistiek dienstverlener draait? Ben je nauwkeurig, analytisch en krijg je energie van cijfers die kloppen? Dan is deze meeloopstage iets voor jou! Voor ons Cash Control team in Rotterdam zoeken we een stagiair(e) die meedraait in het dagelijkse cashmanagement. Je helpt bij het tijdig toewijzen van betalingen, het verwerken van bankafschriften en het bewaken van openstaande posten. Je werkt nauw samen met Credit Control, Invoicing en Accounts Payable en doet zo praktijkervaring op met cash application, reconciliaties en werken in ERP-systeem Exact. Waar ga je werken? Royal Den Hartogh Logistics is een internationale, toonaangevende logistiek dienstverlener voor de chemische, gas-, polymeer- en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. Ons finance team in Nederland telt 20 collega's, verdeeld over onder andere Credit Control, Invoicing, Accounts Payable en Cash Control – en daar kom jij als stagiair(e) terecht. Wat ga je doen? Je bewaakt de dagelijkse Unallocated Cash : je houdt het overzicht bij, volgt openstaande posten op en rapporteert de belangrijkste KPI's. Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen. Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand). Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen. Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken. De ideale kandidaat Je volgt een mbo4- of hbo-opleiding in een financiële richting, zoals Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Bedrijfseconomie

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
